select 
count(bookings.id) as booking_count,
sum(booking_details.provider_price_suggestions_count * bookings.lead_price) as income_per_bookings,
avg(booking_details.provider_price_suggestions_count) as shakhes,
sum(case when members.app_version is null then 0 when members.app_version in ('', ' ', '  ') then 0 else 1 end) as intalled_app,
sum(case when bookings.register_channel_method in (2, 11) then 1 else 0 end) as app_booking_count

from users
inner join bookings on users.id = bookings.member_user_id
and bookings.created_at >= '2026-03-26 00:00:00'
and bookings.created_at <= '2026-03-29 00:00:00'
inner join booking_details on booking_details.booking_id = bookings.id
inner join members on members.id = users.userable_id

where 
users.userable_type = 'App\Models\Member\Member'
